definition: Hospital separations that could potentially have been prevented by timely and adequate primary and community care
source_dataset: AIHW HPF-76 Potentially preventable hospitalisations by small geographic areas
phn_criterion: None stated: assessed at national level (Part B)
national_criterion: At least a 1% reduction in the national rate of total PPH (Part B; the percentage is not fully legible in the published PDF)
comparison_period_used: Year on year for the national criterion; trend and peer position reported for context
caveats: PHNs have limited influence and attribution of acute events is hard; excludes ED and outpatient care; admission practices vary; ICD-10-AM coding changes affect trends; framework lists 18 conditions while AIHW HPF-76 reports 22

definition: Emergency department presentations at triage category 4 or 5 that are not admitted transferred or died and did not arrive by ambulance police or corrections
numerator: Lower urgency ED presentations (all hours; in hours; after hours)
source_dataset: AIHW PHC-23 Use of emergency departments for lower urgency care
phn_criterion: PHN reduction matches or exceeds the national reduction
national_criterion: At least a 1% reduction in the national rate
comparison_period_used: Year on year (assumption to confirm against Part B page 36); change since 2017-18 shown alongside
caveats: Formal public EDs only so regional areas are less comparable; Medicare Urgent Care Clinics affect trends from 1 July 2023; PHNs have limited influence over ED use
